review.title: Neoadjuvant Chemoimmunotherapy for NSCLC: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

semantic_findings.note: 'Resectable' is not operationalized; it depends on stage, surgical assessment, and local practice.
The composition of 'chemoimmunotherapy' (drug classes, cycles, sequencing) is not defined.
'Trial-level data' is not defined; it may exclude pooled analyses, subgroup reports, and some follow-up publications.
The scope of 'without trial-level evidence' is ambiguous; the review later included 6 conference abstracts with trial-level data.
Distinguishing monotherapy from combination therapy requires regimen details; abstracts may not report them.
